messages:
maya: hi team — i'm starting oncall next week but i don't have pager access yet. who should I ping for the PD invite + runbook assignment? also is there a shadow schedule or any required training sims? cc @alex @sarah

alex: hey maya! welcome 🙌 i'll add you to the rotation. quick Q — is your work email maya@redwood.ai?

maya: yep that's the right one, thanks!

sarah: i triggered the PD invite just now, you should get an email from PagerDuty. if it doesn't show up try:
```
pagerduty invite resend --email maya@redwood.ai
```

oncall-bot: scheduled: maya added to oncall-shadow for week starting 2026-04-05. Reminder: runbook read + sim required.

maya: awesome — where's the sim? i skimmed the runbooks but haven't done a drill yet.

jun: we usually run a short sim in #oncall-sims. ping @sarah when you're in there and we'll slot you. quick checklist i send new shads: 
```
- confirm PD login
- read runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/oncall/runbooks
- join shadow shift with your buddy
- complete post-shadow quiz (5-10 min)
```

alex: i'll pair with you for your first shadow. meet Thu 9:30am PT — i'll run a quick walkthrough of incident flow, paging tiers, and the runbook navigation. bring laptop + headphones :coffee:

maya: perfect, thanks everyone! i'll watch for the PD email and join #oncall-sims. will ping if anything fails. :thumbsup:
